verdict.rationale: Typesense docs reference a page titled 'Typesense for AI Agents' and the site's llms.txt states it is 'an open source search engine for developers and AI agents,' suggesting some agent-oriented integration exists, but no evidence details an actual MCP server, tool schema, or specific query/analytics/index operations exposed as callable tools. missing for 10: concrete MCP server spec or tool-calling API definition, documentation of which operations (query/analytics/index) are exposed, and independent/hands-on confirmation of agent tool use.
